formula.name: Opus V Iris Light — 1000uL
formula.body:
# Opus V Iris Light — 1000uL

**Date:** 2026-04-04  
**Purpose:** cleaner and airier branch of the `Opus V` iris idea for lighter compositions  
**Role In The Module Set:** the better option for transparent, clean, and bright modern builds  
**Related Guide:** [Opus_V_Iris_Accord_Family_Guide.md](d:\chatbots\perfume-chem\Opus_V_Iris_Accord_Family_Guide.md)

---

## Intent

This version keeps the `Opus V` iris lineage but deliberately shifts toward:
- more air
- less butter
- less darkness
- less root-mass
- easier layering into clean structures

It is still iris. It is just less weighted.

---

## Formula

Build this as a **1000 uL accord concentrate**.

| # | Material | Dilution | uL | % of Accord | Function |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Alpha Irone | 10% | 250 | 25.0 | Main iris identity |
| 2 | Orivone | neat | 35 | 3.5 | Minimal buttery-metallic body |
| 3 | Orris F-TEC | neat | 60 | 6.0 | Controlled waxy mass |
| 4 | Methyl Ionone Pure | neat | 135 | 13.5 | Smooth iris volume |
| 5 | I-IRIS F-TEC | neat | 95 | 9.5 | Cleaner projection and lift |
| 6 | Alpha Ionone | neat | 50 | 5.0 | Violet-orris flash |
| 7 | Beta Ionone | neat | 35 | 3.5 | Violet depth without too much weight |
| 8 | Allyl Ionone (Ketone V) | neat | 10 | 1.0 | Soft warm bloom at low level |
| 9 | Dihydro Beta Ionone | neat | 80 | 8.0 | Dry transparent woody-violet persistence |
| 10 | Irotyl | neat | 15 | 1.5 | Iris reinforcement |
| 11 | Ultralia | neat | 20 | 2.0 | Cool halo and lift |
| 12 | Carrot Seed EO | neat | 5 | 0.5 | Trace root realism only |
| 13 | Rose Oxide | 1% | 10 | 1.0 | Metallic-cold edge |
| 14 | Hedione | neat | 200 | 20.0 | Major radiance and expansion |
| | **TOTAL** | | **1000** | **100.0** | |

---

## Why This Works

### 1. The heavy floor is mostly gone

No:
- `Bacdanol`
- `Ambrox Super`
- `Vetival`
- `Heliotropin`
- `Coumarin`

That keeps the accord from immediately reading:
- dusty
- dark
- root-powdered
- woody underneath

### 2. The airy iris materials are now doing more work

Compared with the richer versions, this branch leans harder on:
- `I-IRIS F-TEC`
- `Dihydro Beta Ionone`
- `Ultralia`
- `Hedione`

So the result is more:
- transparent
- polished
- bright-edged
- easier to modernize

### 3. The Opus V fingerprint is still there

Even here, the accord still keeps:
- `Alpha Irone`
- a trace of `Orivone`
- `Orris F-TEC`
- the metallic `Rose Oxide` chill

So it does not become generic ionone floral powder.

---

## Mixing Order

1. Add the iris body materials:
   `Orivone`, `Methyl Ionone Pure`, `Orris F-TEC`, `I-IRIS F-TEC`, `Allyl Ionone (Ketone V)`, `Dihydro Beta Ionone`, `Irotyl`, `Ultralia`.
2. Add the irone-violet section:
   `Alpha Ionone`, `Beta Ionone`, `Alpha Irone (10%)`.
3. Add `Hedione`.
4. Add `Carrot Seed EO`.
5. Add `Rose Oxide (1%)` last.
6. Rest `5-7 days` minimum.
7. Best read: `10-14 days`.

---

## How To Use It

- `Clean musk / office iris`: `6-12%` of concentrate
- `Transparent woody / mineral`: `5-10%`
- `Bright floral iris`: `6-14%`
- `Sport-adjacent`: `4-8%`
- `Ozonic / watery`: use cautiously at `3-6%`

This is still not a true aquatic or gym-fresh module. It is just the lightest `Opus V` branch in the system.

---

## Adjustment Knobs

If it is too light and loses character:
- raise `Orivone` by `5-10 uL`
- raise `Orris F-TEC` by `10 uL`

If it still feels too waxy:
- reduce `Orivone` by `5 uL`
- raise `Hedione` by `10 uL`

If it lacks dry persistence:
- raise `Dihydro Beta Ionone` by `10 uL`
- reduce `Methyl Ionone Pure` by `10 uL`

If it needs a cleaner colder edge:
- raise `Ultralia` by `5 uL`
- raise `Rose Oxide (1%)` by `2-3 uL`

---

## Module Check

This version was checked locally after normalizing the `1000 uL` formula into percentage input for the validator:

- `validate_formula()` returned no hard errors
- `analyze_formula_rule_coverage()` returned `22` positive pairs and `0` conflict pairs

The remaining warnings are expected for an accord module:
- high total concentration
- low top notes
- weak base

---

## Bottom Line

This is the right `Opus V` branch when the perfume has to stay:
- cleaner
- brighter
- more transparent
- less root-dense

Use it when the rich master would over-color the whole perfume.

           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 2. Add Dihydro Beta Ionone (8.0%)

  Step 6. Add Methyl Ionone Pure (13.5%)

  Step 12. Add I-IRIS F-TEC (9.5%)

  Step 13. Add Hedione (20.0%)
